risks.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot is not a suitable substitute for therapy, any other medical and health advice, or academic advice.
AI is an increasingly powerful set of tools with the capacity to support learning or to hinder it, depending on how it is used.

responsibilities.quote: Students must adhere to the University’s AI Guidelines when using AI tools.
Staff members who use AI in Teaching and Learning activities must adhere to the University's AI Guidelines.
Students may choose not to use AI for assessment, unless the assessment has been designated as Category D.

Chairs of Faculty Teaching and Learning Committees will collate issues with this policy raised by Schools and are responsible for including a review of the impact of the AI Policy by the Committee at least once a semester.
